signal_evidence.consumer_stress_tier: The U.S. consumer remained healthy, overall economy remained resilient through the first quarter... income growth continued to run ahead of inflation. Consumer spending remained robust.
signal_evidence.credit_quality_trend: The domestic card charge-off rate for the first quarter was 5.1%... the charge-off rate improved by 109 basis points year-over-year.
signal_evidence.auto_credit_trend: Auto losses have been stable at near pre-pandemic levels for the past year... auto charge-offs have been stable at near pre-pandemic levels for the past year.
signal_evidence.capex_direction: We expect to increasingly lean into marketing to take advantage of these compelling market opportunities... we continue to invest in building AI infrastructure and specific AI experiences.
signal_evidence.pricing_power: Revenue margin for the quarter was 16.9%... excluding Discover, year-over-year revenue growth was about 6.8% driven by underlying growth in purchase volume and loans.
signal_evidence.management_tone_shift: The new conflict in the Persian Gulf represents a significant cloud on the horizon.
